name: The Last Days of the Third Age
summary: The Last Days of the Third Age is a full conversion mod for Mount and Blade Warband that brings the player into the world of Middle Earth. In this mod you must select a faction that you fight for and defeat all your enemies to win the war. There are some interesting side quests you can get from listening to rumours or from various commanders but the main goal is still to crush all your enemies and attain victory!
